notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
rationale: Executive Order 12952 (February 24, 1995; 60 FR 11011) has one operative sentence: it amends Executive Order No. 12950 so that the list of Labor Organizations attached to that order includes the International Brotherhood of Firemen & Oilers. The amendment is a self-executing act that was complete on signing, February 24, 1995; the order has no continuing command, delegation, report or duty (the held original was read in full). The inserted name survives only inside Executive Order 12950's list, so its life is the parent's, not this order's command. Executive Order 12950 established an emergency board under the Railway Labor Act whose own terms in the held Federal Register text were: report within 30 days of creation on February 22, 1995, termination on submission of the report, and a 120-day status-quo period. No later held instrument names Executive Order 12952. Recommended provisional status: no, on the order's own terms; the surviving consequence is carried under savings.
